About Quality Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric

The Cornerstone of Quality

As a locally owned and operated business, we’re your neighbors as much as your technicians and plumbers. We have deep roots in the local community and are right there with you to keep your home feeling safe and comfortable, season after season.

Our reason for going into business was simple. We wanted to be the HVAC and plumbing company that we simply couldn’t find in the area—one that not only made its customers feel like all-stars, but it’s employees, too.

Since 2014, we’ve been marching to the beat of our own drum to provide the kind of craftsmanship, company culture and community service that only a local, privately owned company can provide. We’re proud to be different, and even prouder to be Quality.

      Our Core HVAC Services in Tulsa, OK

      At Quality Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric, we’re proud to be the go-to choice for HVAC services in Tulsa, OK. From fast repairs to complete system installations, our team is committed to delivering quality, efficiency, and long-lasting comfort for homes and businesses throughout the area.

      Heating Services

      When winter hits Tulsa, you need a heating system you can rely on. We provide expert furnace repairs, heat pump maintenance, and seasonal service to keep your home warm and energy-efficient. If your current system is failing, we can help you upgrade to a modern, high-efficiency unit.

      Air Conditioning Services

      Tulsa summers can be brutal. That’s why we offer fast, dependable AC repair, system replacements, and preventative tune-ups. We service all major brands and ensure your cooling system performs its best when you need it most — without driving up your energy bills.

      HVAC Maintenance

      Regular maintenance is the key to extending the life of your HVAC system and avoiding unexpected breakdowns. Our HCVAC maintenance plans include system inspections, cleanings, and performance checks to keep everything running efficiently year-round.

      HVAC Installation

      Whether you’re building a new home or replacing an outdated system, our expert team offers full-service HVAC installation in Tulsa, OK. We help you choose the right unit for your space and ensure it’s installed for optimal performance and energy savings. We install furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, and ductless mini-splits — all backed by trusted warranties.

      FAQs – HVAC in Tulsa, OK

      Which HVAC system is best for a commercial building?

      The best HVAC system for a commercial building depends on its size, layout, and specific needs. Common options include packaged systems, split systems, or rooftop units. A professional HVAC contractor can help determine the ideal system for optimal performance and energy efficiency.

      What is a Split HVAC System?

      A split HVAC system consists of two main components: an indoor unit (evaporator) and an outdoor unit (condenser). It is commonly used in residential and commercial settings for efficient heating and cooling. The system’s flexibility allows for customized control of temperature in different zones.

      Why is it beneficial to use a single full-service HVAC company?

      Using a single full-service HVAC company ensures consistent service and a long-term relationship with trusted professionals. It simplifies maintenance, repairs, and system upgrades, and the company becomes familiar with your specific HVAC needs, ensuring better service and cost-effective solutions.

      How often should you check your HVAC system?

      It’s recommended to have your HVAC system checked at least once a year, typically in the spring for cooling systems and fall for heating systems. Regular inspections help prevent breakdowns, improve efficiency, and extend the system’s lifespan by addressing issues before they become major problems.

      What factors influence the time it takes to install an HVAC system?

      The time required to install an HVAC system depends on factors such as the type of system, the complexity of the installation, the size of the building, and the existing infrastructure. Typically, installation can take anywhere from one to several days, depending on these variables.
